name: Smooth Frames
description: Fixes FPS stutters by locking the frame interval so nothing can reset it, and optionally smoothing uneven frame times.

lock-interval.name: Lock frame interval
lock-interval.description: Sets the animation interval to the Target FPS when a level starts, when you resume, and re-applies it if anything changes it mid-level.

target-fps.name: Target FPS
target-fps.description: The frame rate to lock to.

smooth-delta.name: Smooth frame times (experimental)
smooth-delta.description: Blends each frame's delta time with a running average so one late frame does not cause a visible jump. This changes timing slightly, so keep it off for anything you want to be legitimate.
